loyalty_card.description: The card or programme name only, such as Moja Biedronka.
loyalty_card.title: Loyalty Card

app.description: The app name only, such as Lidl Plus, when it is required.
app.title: App

coupon.description: True when a coupon must be activated.
coupon.title: Coupon

minimum_quantity.description: Items to buy for the offer: 2 for 1+1 or a second-item discount, 3 for 2+1 or when bought as 3.
minimum_quantity.title: Minimum Quantity

free_item_rule.description: The printed free-item rule, such as 1+1 GRATIS.
free_item_rule.title: Free Item Rule

percentage_discount.description: The printed discount percentage as a number (37 for -37%).
percentage_discount.title: Percentage Discount

eligible_range.description: The printed products the offer covers when it spans a range, or a printed restriction to selected stores.
eligible_range.title: Eligible Range

text.description: The discount line exactly as printed.
text.title: Text

amount.description: How much it takes off, as a positive number.
amount.title: Amount

DuplicateReceipt.description:
A photo of a receipt the run had stored already, from an earlier photo: the flow
records nothing for it, so it is named and not scored.
DuplicateReceipt.title: DuplicateReceipt

Line.description: One line of the run, scored. An extra line has no text as printed and no label.
Line.title: Line

Metrics.description:
The metrics of schema version 1 the run still keeps; the run is read by its
numbers.
Metrics.title: Metrics

NameDiff.description: A new kind made for a label and named otherwise.
NameDiff.title: NameDiff

Numbers.description: The run's numbers, from its receipts'.
Numbers.title: Numbers

name.description: The printed product name; a range offer keeps its printed range wording (Wszystkie parówki Kraina Wędlin).
name.title: Name

price.description: The printed offer price. A price labelled cena regularna is a reference, not the offer price. Null for a free-item offer (1+1, 2+1) with no other printed price: never 0, never its regular price.
price.title: Price

price_basis.description: The bare unit the price is for, without a number: kg for goods sold by weight; opak. for packaged goods (jar, can, pack), even when printed per szt.; the printed word for fresh items sold per piece, bunch or tray (sztuka, szt., pęczek, tacka).
price_basis.title: Price Basis

pack_size.description: The printed pack wording with its content (Puszka 455 g, Opak. 1 kg, 500 g, 310 g (10 szt.)), without a pack count (1 opak.) or unit price. Null for goods sold by weight (luz, luzem 1 kg) or per piece or bunch.
pack_size.title: Pack Size

quantity.description: The pack content as a number and unit (500 g). Never the basis of a comparison unit price (19,98/1 kg). Null for goods sold by weight (luz, luzem 1 kg) or per piece or bunch (1 szt., 1 pęczek).

reference_price.description: A price whose printed label names it regular or pre-promo (Cena regularna, cena przed obniżką). A price for buying without the card or app or beyond the limit is not a reference: keep it in condition.

lowest_30_days.description: A price whose printed label names the lowest price of the last 30 days.

ambiguous_reference.description: A crossed-out or second price whose type is not printed (no label, or Najniższa cena sprzed pierwszej obniżki), kind unknown; also add 'reference type' to ambiguous_fields.

condition.description: The printed purchase conditions and discount wording (37% taniej, Dostępne w wybranych sklepach). Marketing labels such as SUPERCENA or HIT are not conditions.
condition.title: Condition

valid_from.description: The offer's own printed start date, else the date range printed for the whole page (header or footer). A single printed day (tylko w sobotę 31.10) is both valid_from and valid_to.
valid_from.title: Valid From

valid_to.description: The end date from the same printed range as valid_from.
valid_to.title: Valid To

validity_wording.description: The short printed date phrase used for the dates, such as Od czwartku 29.10 do soboty 31.10; never legal small print.
validity_wording.title: Validity Wording

PromoVerdict.description: One promo of the run: a truth promo, paired or missed, or an extra prediction.
PromoVerdict.title: PromoVerdict

text.description: The product line as printed, with its spelling and spacing, but never the VAT letter, wherever it is printed; that letter goes only in vat.
text.title: Text

quantity.description: The quantity or weight printed for the line, such as 2 szt or 0.512 kg; null when none is printed. Never a pack size read from the product name.

total.description: The line's total before its discounts.
total.title: Total

vat.description: The VAT letter, such as A or C.
vat.title: Vat

discounts.description: The discount lines (rabat, promocja, obniżka) that reduce this line. A discount is never a line of its own.
discounts.title: Discounts

ReadingCounts.description: What reading got right, counted over one receipt or summed over a run.
ReadingCounts.title: ReadingCounts

ReadingMetrics.description:
The reading step's metrics over a run, as rates from 0 to 1; None when there is
nothing to rate.
ReadingMetrics.title: ReadingMetrics

ReadingScore.description: One receipt's reading: its counts, the alignment, and the lines behind the errors.
ReadingScore.title: ReadingScore

ReceiptStep.description: A step's numbers for one receipt.
ReceiptStep.title: ReceiptStep

Recorded.description: What the flow recorded for a read line.
Recorded.title: Recorded

wording.description: The printed label only (Cena regularna), without the amount, asterisks or a trailing colon; null when no label is printed.
wording.title: Wording

RunStep.description: A step's numbers over the run.
RunStep.title: RunStep

Spread.description:
Seconds per receipt over the receipts that didn't fail, nearest rank; None when
every receipt failed.
Spread.title: Spread

StepTimes.description:
The seconds the flow spent on each step for one receipt, measured around the step:
reading and kind choice, their model calls with every retry and wait; database, the
duplicate check, the catalog lookup and the write. A step that didn't run took 0.
StepTimes.title: StepTimes

evals__lines__Misread.description: A detail of a line read other than printed, both as text for a person to read.
evals__lines__Misread.title: Misread
